spec.rawSql:
WITH selected_device AS (
  SELECT split_part(topic, '/', 3) AS device,
         GREATEST(max((payload->'aenergy'->>'total')::double precision)
           - min((payload->'aenergy'->>'total')::double precision), 0) / 1000.0 AS kwh
  FROM mqtt_messages
  WHERE $__timeFilter(received_at)
    AND topic LIKE 'apartment/%/%/status/switch:0'
    AND payload ? 'aenergy'
    AND payload->'aenergy'->>'total' IS NOT NULL
  GROUP BY 1
  HAVING count(*) >= 2
)
SELECT sum(kwh) AS "Selected" FROM selected_device

spec.description: Total energy over the selected dashboard range, summed across outlets with at least two readings.
spec.title: Selected (kWh)

spec.rawSql:
WITH bounds AS (
  SELECT to_timestamp(${__from} / 1000.0) AS start_at,
         to_timestamp(${__to} / 1000.0) AS end_at
), selected_device AS (
  SELECT split_part(topic, '/', 3) AS device,
         GREATEST(max((payload->'aenergy'->>'total')::double precision)
           - min((payload->'aenergy'->>'total')::double precision), 0) / 1000.0 AS kwh
  FROM mqtt_messages, bounds
  WHERE received_at >= bounds.start_at AND received_at <= bounds.end_at
    AND topic LIKE 'apartment/%/%/status/switch:0'
    AND payload ? 'aenergy'
    AND payload->'aenergy'->>'total' IS NOT NULL
  GROUP BY 1
  HAVING count(*) >= 2
), windows AS (
  SELECT n,
         ((b.start_at AT TIME ZONE '${__timezone}') - n * interval '1 day')
           AT TIME ZONE '${__timezone}' AS start_at,
         ((b.end_at AT TIME ZONE '${__timezone}') - n * interval '1 day')
           AT TIME ZONE '${__timezone}' AS end_at
  FROM bounds b CROSS JOIN generate_series(1, ${baseline_days:raw}::int) AS days(n)
  WHERE b.end_at - b.start_at <= interval '1 day'
  UNION ALL
  SELECT n,
         b.start_at - n * (b.end_at - b.start_at) AS start_at,
         b.end_at - n * (b.end_at - b.start_at) AS end_at
  FROM bounds b CROSS JOIN LATERAL generate_series(
    1, floor(EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM (${baseline_days:raw}::int * interval '1 day'))
             / NULLIF(EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM (b.end_at - b.start_at)), 0))::int
  ) AS blocks(n)
  WHERE b.end_at - b.start_at > interval '1 day'
), covered_device AS (
  SELECT w.n, split_part(m.topic, '/', 3) AS device,
         GREATEST(max((m.payload->'aenergy'->>'total')::double precision)
           - min((m.payload->'aenergy'->>'total')::double precision), 0) / 1000.0 AS kwh
  FROM windows w CROSS JOIN bounds b
  JOIN mqtt_messages m ON m.received_at >= w.start_at AND m.received_at <= w.end_at
    AND m.topic LIKE 'apartment/%/%/status/switch:0'
    AND m.payload ? 'aenergy'
    AND m.payload->'aenergy'->>'total' IS NOT NULL
  WHERE w.end_at <= b.start_at
    AND (b.end_at - b.start_at <= interval '1 day'
      OR w.start_at >= b.start_at - ${baseline_days:raw}::int * interval '1 day')
    AND split_part(m.topic, '/', 3) IN (SELECT device FROM selected_device)
  GROUP BY w.n, w.start_at, w.end_at, split_part(m.topic, '/', 3)
  HAVING count(*) >= 2
    AND min(m.received_at) <= w.start_at + interval '15 minutes'
    AND max(m.received_at) >= w.end_at - interval '15 minutes'
), complete_windows AS (
  SELECT n, sum(kwh) AS kwh
  FROM covered_device
  GROUP BY n
  HAVING count(*) = (SELECT count(*) FROM selected_device)
), baseline AS (
  SELECT avg(kwh) AS kwh FROM complete_windows
)
SELECT kwh AS "Prior avg" FROM baseline

spec.description: Average total kWh across complete historical periods within the chosen lookback. For ranges up to one day, compares the same local clock times on preceding days; longer ranges use non-overlapping equal-length blocks. A period is excluded if any selected outlet lacks readings within 15 minutes of either boundary. No complete history means no period qualified.
spec.title: Prior avg (kWh)

spec.rawSql:
WITH bounds AS (
  SELECT to_timestamp(${__from} / 1000.0) AS start_at,
         to_timestamp(${__to} / 1000.0) AS end_at
), selected_device AS (
  SELECT split_part(topic, '/', 3) AS device,
         GREATEST(max((payload->'aenergy'->>'total')::double precision)
           - min((payload->'aenergy'->>'total')::double precision), 0) / 1000.0 AS kwh
  FROM mqtt_messages, bounds
  WHERE received_at >= bounds.start_at AND received_at <= bounds.end_at
    AND topic LIKE 'apartment/%/%/status/switch:0'
    AND payload ? 'aenergy'
    AND payload->'aenergy'->>'total' IS NOT NULL
  GROUP BY 1
  HAVING count(*) >= 2
), windows AS (
  SELECT n,
         ((b.start_at AT TIME ZONE '${__timezone}') - n * interval '1 day')
           AT TIME ZONE '${__timezone}' AS start_at,
         ((b.end_at AT TIME ZONE '${__timezone}') - n * interval '1 day')
           AT TIME ZONE '${__timezone}' AS end_at
  FROM bounds b CROSS JOIN generate_series(1, ${baseline_days:raw}::int) AS days(n)
  WHERE b.end_at - b.start_at <= interval '1 day'
  UNION ALL
  SELECT n,
         b.start_at - n * (b.end_at - b.start_at) AS start_at,
         b.end_at - n * (b.end_at - b.start_at) AS end_at
  FROM bounds b CROSS JOIN LATERAL generate_series(
    1, floor(EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM (${baseline_days:raw}::int * interval '1 day'))
             / NULLIF(EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM (b.end_at - b.start_at)), 0))::int
  ) AS blocks(n)
  WHERE b.end_at - b.start_at > interval '1 day'
), covered_device AS (
  SELECT w.n, split_part(m.topic, '/', 3) AS device,
         GREATEST(max((m.payload->'aenergy'->>'total')::double precision)
           - min((m.payload->'aenergy'->>'total')::double precision), 0) / 1000.0 AS kwh
  FROM windows w CROSS JOIN bounds b
  JOIN mqtt_messages m ON m.received_at >= w.start_at AND m.received_at <= w.end_at
    AND m.topic LIKE 'apartment/%/%/status/switch:0'
    AND m.payload ? 'aenergy'
    AND m.payload->'aenergy'->>'total' IS NOT NULL
  WHERE w.end_at <= b.start_at
    AND (b.end_at - b.start_at <= interval '1 day'
      OR w.start_at >= b.start_at - ${baseline_days:raw}::int * interval '1 day')
    AND split_part(m.topic, '/', 3) IN (SELECT device FROM selected_device)
  GROUP BY w.n, w.start_at, w.end_at, split_part(m.topic, '/', 3)
  HAVING count(*) >= 2
    AND min(m.received_at) <= w.start_at + interval '15 minutes'
    AND max(m.received_at) >= w.end_at - interval '15 minutes'
), complete_windows AS (
  SELECT n, sum(kwh) AS kwh
  FROM covered_device
  GROUP BY n
  HAVING count(*) = (SELECT count(*) FROM selected_device)
), baseline AS (
  SELECT avg(kwh) AS kwh FROM complete_windows
), selected AS (
  SELECT sum(kwh) AS kwh FROM selected_device
)
SELECT CASE WHEN pct IS NOT NULL THEN
    CASE WHEN pct < 0 THEN '-' WHEN pct > 0 THEN '+' ELSE '' END
    || to_char(abs(pct), 'FM999999990.0') || '%'
  END AS "Δ vs avg"
FROM (
  SELECT CASE WHEN baseline.kwh > 0 AND selected.kwh IS NOT NULL
    THEN round(((selected.kwh / baseline.kwh - 1) * 100.0)::numeric, 1)
    END AS pct
  FROM baseline CROSS JOIN selected
) comparison

spec.description: Percent difference between selected total kWh and the average of complete, equal-length historical periods. Negative means lower consumption. No comparison if no historical period has complete boundary coverage, if selected data is missing, or if the historical average is zero.
spec.title: Δ vs avg

spec.rawSql:
WITH per_device AS (
  SELECT
    split_part(topic, '/', 3) AS device,
    (max((payload->'aenergy'->>'total')::double precision)
      - min((payload->'aenergy'->>'total')::double precision)) / 1000.0 AS kwh
  FROM mqtt_messages
  WHERE received_at >= date_trunc('month', CURRENT_TIMESTAMP)
    AND received_at <= CURRENT_TIMESTAMP
    AND topic LIKE 'apartment/%/%/status/switch:0'
    AND payload ? 'aenergy'
  GROUP BY 1
)
SELECT COALESCE(sum(GREATEST(kwh, 0)), 0) AS "MTD" FROM per_device

spec.description: Energy used from the start of the current calendar month through now. Independent of the selected dashboard range.
spec.title: MTD (kWh)

spec.rawSql:
WITH per_device AS (
  SELECT
    $__timeGroupAlias(received_at, $__interval),
    split_part(topic, '/', 3) AS device,
    avg((payload->>'apower')::double precision) AS watts
  FROM mqtt_messages
  WHERE $__timeFilter(received_at)
    AND topic LIKE 'apartment/%/%/status/switch:0'
    AND payload ? 'apower'
  GROUP BY 1, 2
)
SELECT
  time,
  CASE WHEN ${outlet_breakdown:raw} THEN device ELSE 'All outlets' END AS metric,
  sum(watts) AS value
FROM per_device
GROUP BY 1, 2
ORDER BY 1, 2

spec.description: Active power in the selected time range. By outlet shows one series per outlet; off shows their summed power.
spec.title: Active power

spec.rawSql:
WITH per_device AS (
  SELECT
    $__timeGroupAlias(received_at, $__interval),
    split_part(topic, '/', 3) AS device,
    avg((payload->>'voltage')::double precision) AS volts
  FROM mqtt_messages
  WHERE $__timeFilter(received_at)
    AND topic LIKE 'apartment/%/%/status/switch:0'
    AND payload ? 'voltage'
  GROUP BY 1, 2
)
SELECT
  time,
  CASE WHEN ${outlet_breakdown:raw} THEN device || ' voltage' ELSE 'Average voltage' END AS metric,
  avg(volts) AS value
FROM per_device
GROUP BY 1, 2
ORDER BY 1, 2

spec.description: Voltage in the selected time range. By outlet shows each outlet; off shows the average voltage across reporting outlets.
spec.title: Voltage

spec.rawSql:
WITH bounds AS (
  SELECT
    ((CURRENT_TIMESTAMP AT TIME ZONE 'Europe/Madrid')::date - 13) AS first_day,
    (CURRENT_TIMESTAMP AT TIME ZONE 'Europe/Madrid')::date AS today,
    CURRENT_TIMESTAMP AS now_ts
), per_device_day AS (
  SELECT
    (received_at AT TIME ZONE 'Europe/Madrid')::date AS local_day,
    split_part(topic, '/', 3) AS device,
    GREATEST(
      max((payload->'aenergy'->>'total')::double precision)
      - min((payload->'aenergy'->>'total')::double precision),
      0
    ) / 1000.0 AS kwh
  FROM mqtt_messages, bounds
  WHERE received_at >= (first_day::timestamp AT TIME ZONE 'Europe/Madrid')
    AND received_at <= now_ts
    AND topic LIKE 'apartment/%/%/status/switch:0'
    AND payload ? 'aenergy'
  GROUP BY 1, 2
), days AS (
  SELECT generate_series(first_day, today, interval '1 day')::date AS day
  FROM bounds
)
SELECT
  CASE
    WHEN days.day = bounds.today THEN to_char(days.day, 'Dy DD') || ' · now'
    ELSE to_char(days.day, 'Dy DD')
  END AS "Day",
  CASE
    WHEN ${outlet_breakdown:raw} THEN
      COALESCE((
        SELECT jsonb_object_agg(
          p.device,
          round(p.kwh::numeric, 2)
          ORDER BY p.device
        )
        FROM per_device_day p
        WHERE p.local_day = days.day
      ), '{}'::jsonb)::text
    ELSE
      jsonb_build_object(
        'All outlets',
        round(COALESCE((
          SELECT sum(p.kwh)
          FROM per_device_day p
          WHERE p.local_day = days.day
        ), 0)::numeric, 2)
      )::text
  END AS "Series"
FROM days
CROSS JOIN bounds
ORDER BY days.day

spec.description: Last 14 calendar days, independent of the dashboard time picker. By outlet stacks each outlet; off shows apartment total. Today is partial.
spec.title: Energy by day · 14d
